name: Sattu Savoury Breakfast Drink
ingredients: Black pepper and mint to taste
steps: Add sattu to a large jug. Pour in about ½ cup water gradually while whisking to prevent lumps.
Whisk in the remaining water until smooth and drinkable.
Stir in cucumber, coriander, lemon, cumin, black salt and pepper.
Taste and adjust lemon and seasoning. Serve immediately over ice if desired.
note: A no-cook option. Check the sattu label for cross-contact warnings if preparing for someone with food allergies.
